## My request:
does using the wallet requires users to use link by stripe or agentcard?
I’ll compare the wallet guide with the live API’s provider options, since the guide currently shows Link and AgentCard.

**Not necessarily—it depends on the wallet’s `provider`.**

| Provider | User setup |
|---|---|
| `link` | Connect a Link by Stripe wallet |
| `agentcard` | Enroll their card through AgentCard |
| **`kernel`** | Enter card details and email on a **Kernel-hosted enrollment page** |

The native **`provider: "kernel"`** contract does **not require user-facing Link or AgentCard setup**. [Native wallet specification](https://github.com/kernel/kernel-python-sdk/blob/main/src/kernel/types/vaults/kernel_wallet_vault_item_spec.py)

The confusing part is that the [wallet overview](https://www.kernel.sh/docs/integrations/wallets/overview) currently documents only Link and AgentCard, while the API/SDK also defines `kernel`.

**We’ve verified that API option exists; we haven’t verified it’s usable for our project and your card.**

content.text:
**The current API includes `provider: "kernel"` for payment items too.** I checked the actual creation-request schema:

| Item type | Supports `provider: "kernel"` |
|---|---|
| `credential` | Yes—login and other non-payment details |
| `wallet` | Yes—hosted card enrollment |
| `card` | Yes—a purchase using the enrolled card |

This is in [Kernel’s live OpenAPI](https://api.onkernel.com/spec.json), and its official [payment-card model](https://github.com/kernel/kernel-python-sdk/blob/main/src/kernel/types/vaults/kernel_card_vault_item_spec.py) explicitly describes purchase authorization and checkout filling.

The confusion comes from the [wallet overview](https://www.kernel.sh/docs/integrations/wallets/overview): it currently lists only Link and AgentCard. Also, **“Kernel-managed credentials”** on that page means Kernel manages those providers’ application credentials; that phrase alone doesn’t mean `provider: "kernel"`.

**Verified: native Kernel wallet/card request types exist. Still unverified: availability for our project and compatibility with your card.**
